description: Hosted by Women for Kansas, U.S. Congressional candidates gathered October 10 with voters to discuss key election issues including federal spending, taxes/tariffs, war powers, affordability, and immigration. Lauren Reinhold addressed the common concern of affordability affecting everyone across the Big First, citing high prices on goods and the pattern of lowering taxes for the wealthy. She argued against allowing corporations unfettered ability to fund politics, which has entrenched corruption
